verdict.rationale: cubic documents an Analytics API that returns PR-level data on issues flagged and fixed and on AI-authored code. That is a first-party public API, but it is read-only reporting rather than a way to drive the product. No OpenAPI spec was found, and the probe returned 404 on every candidate path. Programmatic control such as requesting reviews and triaging issues is only evidenced through the separate MCP server and CLI surfaces, which belong to other stories. Missing for 10: a documented REST/GraphQL API for triggering reviews, scans and fixes or managing configuration, a published OpenAPI spec, API auth/reference docs, and independent corroboration.
